`invoice_total(amounts)` is now in `invoices/total.py`. It sums `payments.charge.charge(amount)` over the list, so `invoice_total([5, 10])` returns 1500.

I made `invoices` a package by adding an empty `invoices/__init__.py`. The tests are in `tests/test_invoices.py`: one for `[5, 10]` giving 1500, plus an extra one checking that an empty list gives 0.

`python -m pytest -q` ran with all 4 tests passing, including the two existing ones. I haven't committed anything.
